messages:
pager-bot: PAGER: embeddings route /v1/embeddings (region: eu-north-1)  severity=high  p99 token latency > 3s and 5xx spike. Alert: embeddings_prod_tail_sla.

KAI-ONCALL: I'm taking this. First: any recent model/config changes in that pool? Pool health?

MIRA-RT: Checking metrics now. Pool gpu-eu-n-1 has queued requests up from ~15 -> 950 in 7m. batch_window jumped from 18ms -> 420ms, avg_batch_size up to 64. KV cache hitrate for hot prefixes dropped 90% -> 14%. No GPU OOMs.

NOAH-ML: We rolled redwood-lite-3q8 (8-bit quant) to eu-north-1 last night and also applied a config tweak that lowered kv_cache.max_entries_per_worker from 180k -> 60k to save memory. Might be related.

KAI-ONCALL: Hypothesis: quantized variant increased working set; smaller KV cache caused eviction churn and repeated recomputation, leading to long-tail latency. Mitigations to try: 1) failover route to redwood-lite-3fp16, 2) restore kv_cache.max_entries_per_worker for the pool, 3) reduce batch_window to 10ms, 4) clear KV caches to remove corrupted entries. Applying now.

KAI-ONCALL: Commands: ```
# route fallback and batching tweak
infractl route update --route /v1/embeddings --fallback redwood-lite-3fp16 --batch_window 10ms --max_batch_size 40
# scale up pool to relieve backlog
infractl pool scale --pool gpu-eu-n-1 --delta +12 --reason "incident mitigation"
```

TARA-SRE: I'll run a targeted cache invalidate across workers (note: transient warm-up latency expected): ```for w in $(infractl list-workers --pool gpu-eu-n-1); do infractl exec $w --runtime "kv_cache.invalidate_all()"; done```

LINA-SUPPORT: Pulling affected API keys. Early set: cust-northstar, cust-lyra. Opening SRs and notifying account teams.

NOAH-ML: After the fallback and cache clear, telemetry shows p95 down from ~1.5s -> 380ms, p99 from ~3.2s -> 610ms. KV hitrate recovering to ~68% after warm. Strong sign config+quantization interaction.

KAI-ONCALL: Creating revert MR to restore kv_cache.max_entries_per_worker to 180k and pin redwood-lite-3q8 until regression tests pass. MR: infra/config#7815  revert kv cache size & add rollout hold.

SAM-PM: Scheduling a postmortem. I'll set it for tomorrow 16:00 UTC and invite eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre, support, and product. Agenda: timeline, root cause evidence, remediation plan, regression test coverage, rollout gate changes.

TARA-SRE: Quick playbook updates to add: 1) add a specific KV hitrate drop alert (hitrate < 40% sustained 3m), 2) add a step in playbook to verify kv config after model rollouts. I'll file an alerts PR.

MIRA-RT: Runtime follow-ups: expose per-route and per-pool kv hitrate & eviction metrics in Console, add a canary that injects long-sequence requests during quantized rollouts (5% traffic, 1h).

NOAH-ML: ML follow-ups: add long-sequence tail-latency regression tests for 8-bit variants, include memory profiling. I'll own and target integrating into model-onboarding pipeline by 2026-05-12.

KAI-ONCALL: Handoff: it's 15:10 UTC, handing to tara-sre for watch. Current state: FP16 fallback active, caches cleared, pool scaled, revert MR open.

TARA-SRE: Taking over. I'll monitor p99 & errors for 3h and coordinate with support for customer comms. Marking incident record.

pager-bot: Incident record created: incident/2001122334  severity=sev2  owner=kai-oncall.

SAM-PM: Action items (capture & owners):
- NOAH-ML: Implement quantized long-seq perf + memory profiling in model-onboarding; attach artifacts to postmortem (due 2026-05-12).
- MIRA-RT: Implement Console dashboards for per-route/pool KV metrics and canary long-seq traffic rule (due 2026-04-20).
- TARA-SRE: Add KV hitrate alerts and playbook steps; file alerts PR (due 2026-04-10).
- KAI-ONCALL: Verify revert MR merges and confirm pin/unpin timeline (due 2026-04-06).
- LINA-SUPPORT: Customer notifications & SR follow-ups (due 2026-04-05).

LINA-SUPPORT: Draft customer note: "We observed elevated latency and transient 5xx for embeddings in eu-north-1 between 15:02-15:36 UTC. We mitigated by routing to FP16, refreshing caches, and increasing capacity. We're investigating a quantization + KV cache regression and will follow up with the RCA." Sending after PM review.

TARA-SRE: Stabilization: p99 ~600ms, error rate back to baseline. Marking as stabilized at 15:37 UTC. Keeping watch for 2 hours.

NOAH-ML: Early root cause summary for postmortem: redwood-lite-3q8 increased per-token working set on long-context workloads; combined with reduced per-worker KV cache entries caused eviction thrash -> repeated KV miss recomputation -> long-tail latency. Will attach flamegraphs & heap snapshots.

MIRA-RT: Also recommending a synthetic 'kv-pressure' benchmark be added to CI so future kv config changes are validated under realistic request patterns.

SAM-PM: Postmortem invite sent. Please populate the incident doc with traces, heap snapshots, and the revert MR link. We'll review remediation & closure criteria in the meeting.

KAI-ONCALL: Thanks all. Closing pager handoff.

pager-bot: Pager cleared by tara-sre at 15:45 UTC.

[thread ends]
